text:
The candidate hypothesis states that the adsorption mechanisms involve "electrostatic attraction, hydrogen bonding, and n-π interactions." However, the provided evidence (the abstract) makes no mention of these specific mechanisms, only noting that Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations were conducted yielding a negative adsorption energy ($E_{\text{ads}} = -586.56\text{ kcal mol}^{-1}$). Because key claims within the candidate hypothesis are unsupported by the provided evidence, it cannot be accepted.

VERDICT: REJECT
